title: Iran Shoots Down US MQ-1 Drone Over Strategic Strait of Hormuz
text:
Iran Shoots Down US MQ-1 Drone Over Strategic Strait of Hormuz"

"$4 million MQ-1 drone goes down over Hormuz — shot down by ‘advanced defense systems"

"🔆🔅Air defense personnel from the Iranian Army's southeastern sector have identified, intercepted, and destroyed a US MQ-1 unmanned aerial vehicle over the Strait of Hormuz."

"According to a report by Fars News Agency from Bandar Abbas, the drone was tracked and struck by air defense systems deployed in the country's southeast, resulting in its complete destruction."

"The downing of the aircraft was carried out using modern, domestically-produced indigenous air defense systems.
